dashboard.label: PQC-IoT Sentinel — Research Dashboard v6 + Network Resilience

div.h2: PQC IoT Sentinel — Live BL602 24-Hour End-to-End Research Run
div.p: Sender → CoAP/UDP :5683 → Gateway / Receiver | Kyber512-style KEM + HKDF-SHA-256 + AES-256-CCM + per-device HMAC-SHA-256 + authenticated ACK + persistent replay state.
Dashboard scope is filtered by experiment_id. Firmware evidence and host capture-health telemetry are kept separate; event_id and capture_id support deduplication and research traceability.

search.query: index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type=MSG_DELIVERED | dedup event_id | stats count as value
index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type=MSG_DECRYPTED | dedup event_id | stats count as value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type IN (MSG_DELIVERED,MSG_DECRYPTED) | dedup event_id | stats count(eval(event_type="MSG_DELIVERED")) as delivered count(eval(event_type="MSG_DECRYPTED")) as decrypted | eval value=abs(delivered-decrypted) | table value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type IN (PK_AUTH_FAIL,DEVICE_AUTH_FAIL,SENDER_AUTH_FAIL,ACK_AUTH_FAIL,AEAD_AUTH_FAIL,KEY_ID_FAIL,REPLAY_REJECT,MALFORMED_COAP_REJECT,SOURCE_BLOCKED,STATE_PERSIST_FAIL,RNG_FAIL,DEVICE_AUTH_KEY_MISSING,SEND_FAILED) | dedup event_id | stats count as value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware | dedup event_id | stats min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen | eval seconds=last_seen-first_seen | eval value=case( isnull(seconds),"no data", seconds<60,tostring(round(seconds,0))." sec", seconds<3600,tostring(round(seconds/60,1))." min", seconds<86400,tostring(round(seconds/3600,2))." h", true(),tostring(round(seconds/86400,2))." days" ) | table value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware | dedup event_id | stats min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen | eval seconds=last_seen-first_seen | eval value=if(isnull(seconds),0,round(if(seconds>=86400,100,(seconds/86400)*100),2)) | table value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware event_type IN (MSG_DELIVERED,SEND_FAILED) | dedup event_id | stats count(eval(event_type="MSG_DELIVERED")) as delivered count(eval(event_type="SEND_FAILED")) as failed | eval attempts=delivered+failed | eval value=if(attempts=0,0,round((delivered/attempts)*100,3)) | table value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware event_type IN (MSG_DELIVERED,MSG_DECRYPTED) | dedup event_id | stats count(eval(event_type="MSG_DELIVERED")) as delivered count(eval(event_type="MSG_DECRYPTED")) as decrypted | eval hi=if(delivered>=decrypted,delivered,decrypted), lo=if(delivered<=decrypted,delivered,decrypted) | eval value=if(hi=0,0,round((lo/hi)*100,3)) | table value
index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware event_type IN (MSG_DELIVERED,MSG_DECRYPTED) | stats max(sequence) as value
index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware event_type=MSG_RETRY | dedup event_id | stats count as value
index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=host event_type=CAPTURE_HEALTH | stats latest(invalid_or_mismatched) as value | fillnull value=0 value
index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=host event_type=CAPTURE_HEALTH | stats latest(splunk_failed) as value | fillnull value=0 value

search.query: index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware | dedup event_id | eval Device=coalesce(device_id,host,"unknown") | stats latest(_time) as last_seen latest(event_type) as last_event latest(severity) as severity latest(sender_id) as sender_id latest(generation) as generation max(sequence) as max_sequence max(event_counter) as event_counter latest(capture_id) as capture_id by Device role | eval age_seconds=now()-last_seen | eval Status=case(age_seconds < 120,"ONLINE",age_seconds < 300,"IDLE",true(),"OFFLINE") | eval SenderID=if(sender_id>0,printf("0x%08X",sender_id),"-") | eval LastSeen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename role as Role last_event as "Last Event" generation as Generation max_sequence as "Max Sequence" event_counter as "Event Counter" capture_id as "Capture ID" | table Device Role Status "Last Event" LastSeen SenderID Generation "Max Sequence" "Event Counter" "Capture ID"

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type IN (WIFI_CONNECTED,SERIAL_TELEMETRY_READY,CRYPTO_PROFILE_ACTIVE,DEVICE_AUTH_ACTIVE,SENDER_STATE_NEW,PAIRING_CODE_READY,REPLAY_STATE_RESTORED,KEY_ACTIVE,RECEIVER_FINGERPRINT_READY,MONITOR_ACTIVE,GATEWAY_LISTENING,GATEWAY_STATIC_IP,GATEWAY_DISCOVERY_OK,GATEWAY_FALLBACK_IP) | dedup event_id | stats count by event_type | sort - count

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware event_type IN (PK_AUTH_OK,KEM_HKDF_DONE,AEAD_ENCRYPT_DONE,MSG_DELIVERED,DEVICE_AUTH_OK,KEM_DECAP_OK,HKDF_DONE,AEAD_DECRYPT_OK,MSG_DECRYPTED) | dedup event_id | eval Stage=case( event_type="PK_AUTH_OK","01 Sender - PK pin verified", event_type="KEM_HKDF_DONE","02 Sender - KEM/HKDF", event_type="AEAD_ENCRYPT_DONE","03 Sender - AEAD encrypt", event_type="DEVICE_AUTH_OK","04 Gateway - device HMAC", event_type="KEM_DECAP_OK","05 Gateway - KEM decap", event_type="HKDF_DONE","06 Gateway - HKDF", event_type="AEAD_DECRYPT_OK","07 Gateway - AEAD decrypt", event_type="MSG_DECRYPTED","08 Gateway - message decrypted", event_type="MSG_DELIVERED","09 Sender - authenticated ACK" ) | chart count over Stage by role
index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type IN (MSG_DELIVERED,MSG_DECRYPTED) | dedup event_id | timechart span=10m count by event_type limit=2 useother=f
index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" sequence>0 | dedup event_id | timechart span=10m max(sequence) by role

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type IN (PK_AUTH_FAIL,DEVICE_AUTH_FAIL,SENDER_AUTH_FAIL,ACK_AUTH_FAIL,AEAD_AUTH_FAIL,KEY_ID_FAIL,REPLAY_REJECT,MALFORMED_COAP_REJECT,SOURCE_BLOCKED,RATE_LIMIT_HIT,KEY_ROTATION_REQUIRED,STATE_PERSIST_FAIL,RNG_FAIL,DEVICE_AUTH_KEY_MISSING,SEND_FAILED,GATEWAY_DISCOVERY_FAIL) | dedup event_id | stats count by event_type | sort - count

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type IN (PK_AUTH_FAIL,DEVICE_AUTH_FAIL,SENDER_AUTH_FAIL,ACK_AUTH_FAIL,AEAD_AUTH_FAIL,KEY_ID_FAIL,REPLAY_REJECT,MALFORMED_COAP_REJECT,SOURCE_BLOCKED,RATE_LIMIT_HIT,KEY_ROTATION_REQUIRED,STATE_PERSIST_FAIL,RNG_FAIL,DEVICE_AUTH_KEY_MISSING,SEND_FAILED,GATEWAY_DISCOVERY_FAIL) | dedup event_id | timechart span=30m count by event_type limit=15 useother=f
index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type=DUPLICATE_ACK | dedup event_id | stats count as value
index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type=REPLAY_REJECT | dedup event_id | stats count as value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type=STATE_PERSIST_FAIL | dedup event_id | stats count as value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type IN (MSG_RETRY,RATE_LIMIT_HIT,SOURCE_BLOCKED,REPLAY_REJECT,MALFORMED_COAP_REJECT,DUPLICATE_ACK) | dedup event_id | stats count as Count latest(_time) as LastSeen by role event_type action | eval LastSeen=strftime(LastSeen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename role as Role event_type as Event action as Action | sort - Count

panel.title: 24-Hour Endurance — Delivery / Decryption / Retry Rate (30 min bins)

search.query: index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type IN (MSG_DELIVERED,MSG_DECRYPTED,MSG_RETRY,SEND_FAILED) | dedup event_id | timechart span=30m count by event_type limit=4 useother=f

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware | dedup event_id | stats min(_time) as Start max(_time) as End count(eval(event_type="MSG_DELIVERED")) as Delivered count(eval(event_type="MSG_DECRYPTED")) as Decrypted count(eval(event_type="MSG_RETRY")) as Retries count(eval(event_type="SEND_FAILED")) as SendFailures count(eval(event_type="DEVICE_AUTH_FAIL" OR event_type="SENDER_AUTH_FAIL" OR event_type="PK_AUTH_FAIL" OR event_type="ACK_AUTH_FAIL" OR event_type="AEAD_AUTH_FAIL")) as AuthFailures count(eval(event_type="REPLAY_REJECT")) as ReplayRejects count(eval(event_type="STATE_PERSIST_FAIL")) as PersistFailures max(sequence) as MaxSequence dc(capture_id) as CaptureStreams dc(device_id) as Devices | eval DurationHours=round((End-Start)/3600,3) | eval Hi=if(Delivered>=Decrypted,Delivered,Decrypted), Lo=if(Delivered<=Decrypted,Delivered,Decrypted) | eval MatchPct=if(Hi=0,0,round((Lo/Hi)*100,4)), Gap=abs(Delivered-Decrypted) | eval DeliveredPerHour=if(DurationHours=0,0,round(Delivered/DurationHours,2)) | eval Start=strftime(Start,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), End=strftime(End,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename DurationHours as "Duration h" MatchPct as "E2E Match %" Gap as "E2E Gap" DeliveredPerHour as "Delivered / h" SendFailures as "Send Failures" AuthFailures as "Auth Failures" ReplayRejects as "Replay Rejects" PersistFailures as "Persist Failures" MaxSequence as "Max Sequence" CaptureStreams as "Capture Streams" | table Start End "Duration h" Delivered Decrypted "E2E Gap" "E2E Match %" "Delivered / h" Retries "Send Failures" "Auth Failures" "Replay Rejects" "Persist Failures" "Max Sequence" Devices "Capture Streams"

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=host event_type=CAPTURE_HEALTH | stats latest(_time) as LastUpdate latest(captured) as FirmwareCaptured latest(queued) as FirmwareQueued latest(splunk_sent) as FirmwareSent latest(splunk_failed) as HECFailed latest(invalid_or_mismatched) as InvalidSerial latest(capture_uptime_seconds) as UptimeSeconds latest(capture_id) as CaptureID | eval LastUpdate=strftime(LastUpdate,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval "Capture Uptime"=case(UptimeSeconds<60,tostring(round(UptimeSeconds,0))." sec",UptimeSeconds<3600,tostring(round(UptimeSeconds/60,1))." min",true(),tostring(round(UptimeSeconds/3600,2))." h") | rename FirmwareCaptured as "Valid Firmware Events" FirmwareQueued as Queued FirmwareSent as "HEC Sent" HECFailed as "HEC Failed" InvalidSerial as "Invalid / Rejected Serial" CaptureID as "Capture ID" | table LastUpdate "Capture Uptime" "Valid Firmware Events" Queued "HEC Sent" "HEC Failed" "Invalid / Rejected Serial" "Capture ID"

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware | dedup event_id | eval Device=coalesce(device_id,host,"unknown") | eval Severity=upper(coalesce(severity,"INFO")) | eval Action=coalesce(action,"-") | eval SenderID=if(sender_id>0,printf("0x%08X",sender_id),"-") | table _time Device role SenderID generation sequence event_type Severity Action event_counter event_id | rename _time as Time role as Role generation as Generation sequence as Sequence event_type as Event event_counter as "Event Counter" event_id as "Event ID" | sort - Time | head 60

div.h2: Network Resilience — Routed Pi 1 Impairment Evidence
div.p: Sender on BL602-LAB → Pi 1 routing/NAT → receiver. Profiles are tagged by the host capture bridge so delay, jitter, loss, retry recovery and fail-closed outcomes can be compared without mixing runs.
PQC_BENCH is host-derived from the firmware [BENCH] serial line; native firmware security events retain origin=firmware.

search.query: index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type=PQC_BENCH role=sender network_profile="$net_tok$" run_id="$run_tok$" attempts>1 ok=1 | stats count as value
index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware event_type=MSG_RETRY network_profile="$net_tok$" run_id="$run_tok$" | dedup event_id | stats count as value
index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware event_type=SEND_FAILED network_profile="$net_tok$" run_id="$run_tok$" | dedup event_id | stats count as value
index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type=PQC_BENCH role=sender network_profile="$net_tok$" run_id="$run_tok$" | stats count as value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" network_profile="$net_tok$" run_id="$run_tok$" event_type IN (PQC_BENCH,MSG_DELIVERED,MSG_RETRY,SEND_FAILED,NETWORK_PROFILE_START) | stats count(eval(event_type="PQC_BENCH" AND role="sender")) as BenchSamples count(eval(event_type="MSG_DELIVERED")) as Delivered count(eval(event_type="MSG_RETRY")) as Retries count(eval(event_type="SEND_FAILED")) as SendFailures count(eval(event_type="PQC_BENCH" AND role="sender" AND attempts>1 AND ok=1)) as RetryRecoveries avg(eval(if(event_type="PQC_BENCH" AND role="sender" AND ok=1,rtt_ms,null()))) as AvgRTT_ms perc50(eval(if(event_type="PQC_BENCH" AND role="sender" AND ok=1,rtt_ms,null()))) as MedianRTT_ms perc95(eval(if(event_type="PQC_BENCH" AND role="sender" AND ok=1,rtt_ms,null()))) as P95RTT_ms max(eval(if(event_type="PQC_BENCH" AND role="sender" AND ok=1,rtt_ms,null()))) as MaxRTT_ms values(configured_delay_ms) as Delay_ms values(configured_jitter_ms) as Jitter_ms values(configured_loss_pct) as Loss_pct values(impairment_target) as Target by network_profile run_id | eval AvgRTT_ms=round(AvgRTT_ms,2), MedianRTT_ms=round(MedianRTT_ms,2), P95RTT_ms=round(P95RTT_ms,2), MaxRTT_ms=round(MaxRTT_ms,2) | sort network_profile run_id

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type=PQC_BENCH role=sender ok=1 network_profile="$net_tok$" run_id="$run_tok$" | timechart span=10s avg(rtt_ms) as AvgRTT_ms by network_profile limit=10 useother=f

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type=PQC_BENCH role=sender network_profile="$net_tok$" run_id="$run_tok$" | eval Outcome=if(ok=1,"ok","failed") | stats count by network_profile attempts Outcome | eval Series="attempts=".attempts." ".Outcome | chart sum(count) over network_profile by Series

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" event_type=PQC_BENCH role=sender network_profile="$net_tok$" run_id="$run_tok$" attempts>1 ok=1 | table _time run_id network_profile sequence rtt_ms attempts configured_loss_pct configured_delay_ms configured_jitter_ms impairment_target | rename _time as Time run_id as "Run ID" network_profile as Profile sequence as Sequence rtt_ms as "RTT ms" attempts as Attempts configured_loss_pct as "Loss %" configured_delay_ms as "Delay ms" configured_jitter_ms as "Jitter ms" impairment_target as Target | sort - Time

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware network_profile="$net_tok$" run_id="$run_tok$" event_type IN (MSG_RETRY,SEND_FAILED) | dedup event_id | table _time run_id network_profile role sequence event_type action severity | rename _time as Time run_id as "Run ID" network_profile as Profile role as Role sequence as Sequence event_type as Event action as Action severity as Severity | sort - Time

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=host event_type IN (NETWORK_PROFILE_START,NETWORK_PROFILE_END) network_profile="$net_tok$" run_id="$run_tok$" | table _time event_type run_id network_profile configured_delay_ms configured_jitter_ms configured_loss_pct impairment_direction impairment_target capture_uptime_seconds captured derived_bench | rename _time as Time event_type as Marker run_id as "Run ID" network_profile as Profile configured_delay_ms as "Delay ms" configured_jitter_ms as "Jitter ms" configured_loss_pct as "Loss %" impairment_direction as Direction impairment_target as Target capture_uptime_seconds as "Uptime s" derived_bench as "Bench events" | sort - Time

div.p: Classical comparison path: DTLS 1.2 / ECDHE P-256 / ECDSA P-256 / AES-256-CCM / CoAP over UDP :5684. Kept separate from PQC application-protocol KPIs because authentication and session semantics differ.

search.query: index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" profile=dtls_aes256 role=sender event_type IN (DTLS_HEALTH,DTLS_RUN_COMPLETE) | stats latest(messages_success) as value | fillnull value=0 value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" profile=dtls_aes256 role=sender event_type IN (DTLS_HEALTH,DTLS_RUN_COMPLETE) | stats latest(messages_failed) as value | fillnull value=0 value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" profile=dtls_aes256 role=sender event_type IN (DTLS_HEALTH,DTLS_RUN_COMPLETE) | stats latest(handshakes_success) as value | fillnull value=0 value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" profile=dtls_aes256 role=sender event_type IN (DTLS_HEALTH,DTLS_RUN_COMPLETE) | stats latest(handshakes_failed) as value | fillnull value=0 value

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" profile=dtls_aes256 event_type=DTLS_HANDSHAKE_OK | stats count as Handshakes avg(handshake_ms) as mean_ms median(handshake_ms) as median_ms stdev(handshake_ms) as sd_ms perc95(handshake_ms) as p95_ms perc99(handshake_ms) as p99_ms min(handshake_ms) as min_ms max(handshake_ms) as max_ms by role | eval mean_ms=round(mean_ms,2),median_ms=round(median_ms,2),sd_ms=round(sd_ms,2),p95_ms=round(p95_ms,2),p99_ms=round(p99_ms,2),min_ms=round(min_ms,2),max_ms=round(max_ms,2) | rename role as Role mean_ms as "Mean ms" median_ms as "Median ms" sd_ms as "SD ms" p95_ms as "P95 ms" p99_ms as "P99 ms" min_ms as "Minimum ms" max_ms as "Maximum ms" | table Role Handshakes "Mean ms" "Median ms" "SD ms" "P95 ms" "P99 ms" "Minimum ms" "Maximum ms"

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" profile=dtls_aes256 event_type=DTLS_MESSAGE_OK role=sender | stats count as Messages avg(rtt_ms) as mean_ms median(rtt_ms) as median_ms stdev(rtt_ms) as sd_ms perc95(rtt_ms) as p95_ms perc99(rtt_ms) as p99_ms min(rtt_ms) as min_ms max(rtt_ms) as max_ms | eval mean_ms=round(mean_ms,2),median_ms=round(median_ms,2),sd_ms=round(sd_ms,2),p95_ms=round(p95_ms,2),p99_ms=round(p99_ms,2),min_ms=round(min_ms,2),max_ms=round(max_ms,2) | rename mean_ms as "Mean ms" median_ms as "Median ms" sd_ms as "SD ms" p95_ms as "P95 ms" p99_ms as "P99 ms" min_ms as "Minimum ms" max_ms as "Maximum ms" | table Messages "Mean ms" "Median ms" "SD ms" "P95 ms" "P99 ms" "Minimum ms" "Maximum ms"

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" profile=dtls_aes256 role=sender event_type=DTLS_HEALTH | timechart span=10m latest(messages_success) as Successful latest(messages_failed) as Failed

index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" profile=dtls_aes256 event_type IN (DTLS_HANDSHAKE_FAIL,DTLS_MESSAGE_FAIL,DTLS_ERROR,DTLS_SERIAL_ERROR) | eval Device=coalesce(device,device_id,host,"unknown") | eval Reason=coalesce(reason,error,message,"unspecified") | stats count as Count latest(_time) as last_seen by Device role event_type Reason | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename role as Role event_type as Event last_seen as "Last Seen" | table Device Role Event Reason Count "Last Seen" | sort - Count

panel.title: All Firmware Event Types — Current Experiment

search.query: index=pqc_iot sourcetype="pqc:iot:event" experiment_id="$exp_tok$" origin=firmware | dedup event_id | stats count by role event_type | sort - count
